svg.title: The Strutrix Studio window: a four-storey braced steel building drawn in 3D and coloured by each member's AISC 360-22 utilisation, the selected column's properties and design result beside it, the Model Explorer, and the command line reporting the run and the design
svg.text: Analysed 38 combinations; 38 have a result, each in equilibrium.
